title: HW↔MLOPS-001: Hardware Platform Profile + Model-Target Packaging Constraints (DERIVED)
description: DERIVED / PROVISIONAL — there is NO direct §6 contract on either the Hardware Engineer or the MLOps Engineer side (HARDWARE_ENGINEER_SKILL §6 lists no MLOps; MLOPS_ENGINEER_SKILL §6 lists no Hardware Engineer). The relationship is mediated: the model flash budget is set by the Architect (ARCH↔MLOPS-001), the on-device hardware-ID match and flash-budget-fit are enforced through FW↔MLOPS-001, and sensor characterization for modeling flows through HW↔ML-001. This schema reconstructs the plausible direct interface (hardware platform profile ↔ model-target packaging constraints) for machine validation; per its x-macp.source_status it mandates a COUNTER rather than a binding CONFIRM. No budgets are invented.

hardware_platform_profile.description: HW→MLOPS: target hardware profile relevant to model packaging.

mlops_packaging_constraints.description: MLOPS→HW: hardware-target packaging constraints (subordinate to the ARCH-set flash budget).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Provisional/DERIVED edge — no §6 contract exists on either side; the model flash budget is the Architect's (ARCH↔MLOPS-001) and on-device hardware-ID/flash-fit is enforced via FW↔MLOPS-001. Agents coordinate provisionally and must COUNTER for ratification.

mediation.rationale: No direct contract needed: the only hardware fact relevant to model packaging is the model flash/RAM budget, which is Architect-owned (ARCH↔MLOPS-001); on-device hardware-ID match and flash-fit are enforced through FW↔MLOPS-001.

x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (provisional — to be set by the ratifying §6 contract / CCR)
confirm_conditions: available flash/RAM and any arena limit carry explicit units
the model flash budget defers to ARCH↔MLOPS-001 (Architect-owned)
the hardware-ID match / flash-budget-fit defers to FW↔MLOPS-001
reject_conditions: a flash, RAM, or arena quantity emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
a model flash budget set here instead of by the Architect (ARCH↔MLOPS-001 ownership)
this DERIVED schema treated as a binding contract — it is provisional pending §6 ratification
counter_conditions: ALWAYS COUNTER: request ratification of a real HW↔MLOPS §6 contract (or confirm the relationship is intentionally mediated via ARCH/FW) via a CCR before any binding CONFIRM
a packaging constraint conflicts with the Architect flash budget — route the trade through ARCH↔MLOPS-001 (ADR on exceedance)
